rubric.role_summary: Founding commercial leader for an AI operating system serving real estate agencies in Spain. Build the go-to-market engine from zero, close initial agency accounts, develop a repeatable sales process, and eventually lead the commercial team.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding commercial leader for an AI operating system serving real estate agencies in Spain. Build the go-to-market engine from zero, close initial agency accounts, develop a repeatable sales process, and eventually lead the commercial team.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Has carried a sales quota and personally closed deals.
- Has zero-to-one experience in an early-stage environment, or has built a territory, vertical, or channel from nothing in a fast-paced company.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Sales experience with SMBs or traditional, relationship-driven sectors in Spain, such as real estate, insurance, or professional services.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Barcelona, Spain area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

location.requirement_text: Location: Greater Barcelona, Spain area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. soft_requirements: Hunter mentality: persistence, competitiveness, and proactively creating opportunities.
Builder mindset, ownership, and accountability for commercial results.

interpretation.user_instruction: for multiple locations, accept either one, broaden the area to the general area if it's a specific city, if remote + a location, please force them into the location, follow the text rather than the metadata, for x-y years exp, unbound the top but evaluate obviously overqualified candidates as failures in the final fit eval, other than that, assume the less strict of interpretations (eg masters required versus masters or phd, eval as if masters or phd)
